subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden unless the active model provider is `xai`, including for existing users who intentionally combine non-xAI models with xAI tools?
rationale: The source-level bug is real, but the fix deliberately changes a credential-backed provider billing boundary and can remove tools from existing cross-provider workflows, so automation should not choose the permanent policy alone.

options.title: Approve fail-closed xAI model gate
options.body: Hide the xAI-billed tools unless `activeModel.provider` is `xai`, but require tests, docs, and current-head proof before merge.

options.title: Require explicit cross-provider opt-in
options.body: Preserve compatibility for intentional mixed-provider use by adding an explicit opt-in or allowlist before hiding unknown or non-xAI contexts.

options.title: Pause for a broader billed-tool policy
options.body: Defer this PR until provider-hosted and billed tool exposure is designed consistently across providers.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed xAI model gate
recommendation.body: Hide the xAI-billed tools unless `activeModel.provider` is `xai`, but require tests, docs, and current-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history on the active-model context and provider-boundary policy touched by this PR.
